title: Tracker Dispatch State
description: Per-machine record of what has been filed and which MCP server name worked. .project/ is gitignored, so this does not travel: cross-machine deduplication relies on the jos-issue identity marker embedded in each filed issue's description, not on this file.

mcp_server.description: The server segment that resolved to a real tool. Written by reconcile so the guess happens once per repository rather than once per run.

last_block_token.description: Hash of the pending queue at the moment the Stop dispatcher last blocked. The primary brake: the same queue produces the same token, so a second block cannot fire for it.
